title: Grusch has no information on Lazar

tellings.quote: I have no information on Bob Lazar,

plain: A UFO whistleblower named David Grusch, who testified before Congress in 2023, says he has nothing to back up Bob Lazar, a man who said in 1989 that he had worked on alien craft at a secret site in Nevada. Grusch tells Michels plainly, "I have no information on Bob Lazar," so Lazar's account gets no support from what Grusch learned.
